indicator_name: Weighted average rates on bank loans issued in the month: total, by borrower, by purpose (mortgage, consumer), by enterprise size and maturity, KZT and FX
description: Средневзвешенные ставки по кредитам, выданным банками за месяц: всего, по заёмщикам, по целям (ипотечные, потребительские), по размеру предприятия и срочности, в тенге и в валюте
unit: % per annum, weighted by the volume issued in the month
methodology: NBK formId=27 «Кредиты банковского сектора экономике - ставки», 2022-01 onward, one row per aggregation level (agg_level 1-4). Items <KZT|FX>[.<ALL|BUS|HH>[.<purpose or size>[.<ST|LT>]]]: KZT.ALL all loans in tenge; KZT.HH.MORTGAGE the mortgage rate (10.69 % in August 2026, subsidised programmes included), KZT.HH.CONSUMER 22.29 %, KZT.BUS.LARGE / .MEDIUM / .SMALL, and the same by maturity. Dated by the month the loans were issued: the NBK stamps a month's rate with the 1st of the next month (as form 486, LOAN_RATE_ISSUED_*). KZT.BUS (21.21 %) differs from LOAN_RATE_ISSUED_LEGAL_KZT (form 486, 19.35 %): form 27's business entities include individual entrepreneurs.
